SELECT id, shop_id, item_name, category_id, is_seasonal FROM items WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM records WHERE records.item_id = items.id)
AND ( item_name COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE CONCAT('%', #{likeKeyword}, '%')
OR LOWER(item_name) = LOWER(#{sameKeyword})
)
ORDER BY
LOWER(item_name) = LOWER(#{sameKeyword}) DESC,
item_name LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, shop_id, item_name, category_id, is_seasonal FROM items WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM records WHERE records.item_id = items.id) ORDER BY item_name, id

SELECT items.id, items.shop_id, items.item_name, items.category_id, items.is_seasonal FROM items LEFT JOIN ( SELECT records.item_id, COUNT(*) AS record_count, MAX(records.eaten_on) AS last_eaten_on FROM records WHERE records.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY records.item_id ) AS my_item_records ON my_item_records.item_id = items.id WHERE items.shop_id = #{shopId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM records WHERE records.item_id = items.id) ORDER BY COALESCE(my_item_records.record_count, 0) DESC, my_item_records.last_eaten_on DESC, items.item_name, items.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, shop_id, item_name, category_id, is_seasonal FROM items WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND LOWER(item_name) = LOWER(#{itemName})
SELECT id, shop_id, item_name, category_id, is_seasonal FROM items WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND LOWER(item_name) = LOWER(#{itemName}) FOR SHARE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO items (shop_id, item_name, category_id, is_seasonal) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{itemName}, #{categoryId}, #{isSeasonal})
